# A change of appointment is two changes

The clinic moved the appointment and the neighbour who drives Mum cannot make the new time. The email describes one alteration; our arrangements contain several dependencies. Put the transport booking beside the date in [[Care arrangements]]. I don't want a more elaborate personal system to become the answer to an institution that keeps changing its mind.
